summary: Fixed visual regressions in the app's settings screen by consolidating the orphaned 'Agent resources' sidebar item into the 'This device' group, replacing a bespoke tab bar with the app's existing segmented control, reverting the Agent settings instructions section from a two-pane workbench back to stacked full-width editor cards, and narrowing the Extensions page to the default content width.
decisions: Merged the 'Agent resources' nav item into the 'This device' group instead of leaving it as a lone orphan item in its own untitled group.
Replaced the bespoke `agent-resource-nav` tab bar with the app's existing `segmented`/`segmented-option` control for visual consistency with the Appearance toggle and Skills filter.

Reverted the instructions section from a two-pane library-plus-editor workbench to stacked full-width editor cards (System prompt, Global AGENTS.md), because the workbench pattern was inappropriate for only 2 items and left most of the sidebar empty.
Limited the 1180px workbench width to Skills only; narrowed the Extensions page back to the default 680px content width because its simple switch-rows did not benefit from the wider layout.
Added `[data-ui='settings-content'] > [data-ui='segmented'] { justify-self: start; }` so the reused segmented control hugs its content rather than stretching to the grid track width.
Removed the now-dead `workbench` prop and its associated CSS from `InstructionsEditor.svelte` and `instructions-editor.css`.
Work was verified and not committed; awaiting confirmation before staging.
